Package org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery

Class BeanQueryContext.Builder<T,SELF extends BeanQueryContext.Builder<T,SELF>>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.juneau.commons.beanquery.BeanQueryContext.Builder<T,SELF>
Type Parameters:
T - The row type.
SELF - The concrete builder type, returned by every setter.
Direct Known Subclasses:
InMemoryBeanQueryContext.Builder, SqlBeanQueryContext.Builder
Enclosing class:
BeanQueryContext<T>
public abstract static class BeanQueryContext.Builder<T,SELF extends BeanQueryContext.Builder<T,SELF>> extends Object
The settings every engine's context builder shares.

Single-argument problems throw IllegalArgumentException from the setter. Missing or conflicting settings throw IllegalStateException from build().

    • maxLimit

      public SELF maxLimit(Integer value)
      Sets the largest limit a query can ask for; larger limits and limit=-1 are clamped to it. Default: 1000.

      If this builder's defaultLimit was never explicitly set (it is still QuerySettings's own baseline default, or — for a builder from BeanQueryContext.copy() — still whatever the source context had), narrowing maxLimit below it auto-narrows defaultLimit to match, rather than leaving the two in conflict. An explicitly-chosen defaultLimit is never silently changed by this setter — a resulting conflict is left for build() to reject.

      Parameters:
      value - The cap, or null for no cap. Must be positive if set.
      Returns:
      This object.
